verdict.line: You lose if you E (Apprehend) into an up Riposte or let her land a full four-vital R combo; you win if you bait her parry first and all-in while it's on cooldown.

brief.thesis: This lane is decided by one interaction: Fiora's W (Riposte) negates the first ability or auto that hits her, and Darius has no engage tool besides E (Apprehend) and autos. If you throw E into an up Riposte you get stunned and lose the trade outright; if you bait the parry with a Q (Decimate) edge or an auto first, Fiora has no other escape or hard CC and the all-in is yours. Her Q (Lunge) resets on any champion hit, so she can poke and reposition for free unless you deny that with wave state.

theirWindow.when: Riposte is up and she has wave to Lunge off
theirWindow.what: She will Q (Lunge) in for a vital proc or bait your E, then Riposte the follow-up. Don't throw E or a committed auto here — hold and just trade with Q (Decimate) edge damage instead.

yourWindow.when: Riposte was just used or is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Immediately engage E (Apprehend) into W (Crippling Strike) into auto-Q chain. She has no dash to escape the pull and no CC to stop the all-in once the parry is spent.

powerCurve.note: Both poke with Q, no all-ins land clean
Q resets let her poke and reposition freely
Both ults spike; parry bait decides fights
Bruiser items + stacked passive true damage snowball
Teamfight-dependent; she splits, you need picks

start.why: Sustain through her Q poke and enough burst to threaten a level 2-3 all-in before her Riposte timing gets comfortable

boots.why: Cuts down the extra auto damage from her E (Bladework) and reduces overall AD trading damage in extended fights

core.why: Armor shred plus haste lets your E-W-Q loop come back faster and keeps her squishier through the fight
The shield and tenacity blunt her all-in burst and stop a Riposte stun from chaining into a kill
Damage-over-time conversion outlasts her vital-proc poke and keeps you alive through her R lifesteal window

situational.when: she is out-healing your damage with her passive procs or R (Grand Challenge) lifesteal
you are being dove or need a second chance to close out a fight after she taunts you with a full R combo
she or another enemy AD carry is building crit/lifesteal heavy and out-sustaining your team
the enemy jungler or mid is heavy AP and you need the extra healing on top of Death's Dance

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the prolonged trades this lane forces once Riposte is baited out, and the healing keeps you ahead of her vital-proc sustain

summoners.why: Ignite punishes her all-in and cuts the healing from her R (Grand Challenge) or passive vital procs, turning close trades into kills

playing.title: Bait Riposte before you engage
playing.detail: Throw a Q edge or a single auto first to see if she reacts. Only commit E (Apprehend) once her W is confirmed down or on cooldown.

playing.title: Track your Hemorrhage stacks on her
playing.detail: At 5 stacks your next ability becomes Noxian Might, adding true damage. Time your all-in window around having this ready.

playing.title: Freeze to deny her Q resets
playing.detail: Her Lunge refreshes on any champion hit, so keeping the wave near your tower cuts down her free poke and reposition angles.

playing.title: Save R for a clean execute, not a gamble
playing.detail: Hold Noxian Guillotine until she's near 20-25% health so it kills cleanly and can reset onto another target instead of trading even.

playing.title: Respect a channeled R (Grand Challenge)
playing.detail: If she starts revealing all four vitals, disengage or slow her with W (Crippling Strike) to break the channel — a full combo heals and taunts you.

playing.title: Don't chase her Q dashes
playing.detail: Chasing into her Lunge range just resets her cooldown again and wastes your own cooldowns for nothing.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names reflect the last patch I have solid data on (mid-2025 era Black Cleaver/Death's Dance bruiser build); verify Darius and Fiora haven't been reworked and that these items still exist as named on patch 16.18.1 before finalizing the build.
